hints.title: Step 1: Resetting the encoder
hints.content: Use `driveMotor.setMode(DcMotor.RunMode.STOP_AND_RESET_ENCODER);` to zero out the encoder count.

hints.title: Step 2: Setting the target
hints.content: Use `driveMotor.setTargetPosition(1000);` to tell the motor where to go. This must be done before setting RUN_TO_POSITION mode.

hints.title: Step 3: Setting the run mode
hints.content: Use `driveMotor.setMode(DcMotor.RunMode.RUN_TO_POSITION);` to activate position control mode.

hints.title: Step 4: Starting the motor
hints.content: After waitForStart(), use `driveMotor.setPower(0.5);` to start the motor moving toward the target. In RUN_TO_POSITION, this is the maximum speed.
